description: Defines the EntityAccessDeniedHttpException class which extends a cacheable HTTP exception to include entity-specific access denial information within Drupal's JSON:API module.

classes.name: EntityAccessDeniedHttpException
classes.description: An exception class that provides detailed information about access denial related to a specific entity in Drupal's JSON:API module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the exception with entity, access result, pointer, message, relationship field, previous exception, and code.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error details array containing entity, pointer, reason, and relationship field.
